`enum Align`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.utils.align` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Align.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/utils/align/Align.java)

A side or the middle along one axis: start, center or end.

## Description

It sets the anchor of a node, the alignment of a layout, of a text or of a UI on the window.
